subject.title: feat(browser): send pages to OpenClaw from the Chrome extension

question: After the selection-payload disclosure is fixed, should OpenClaw adopt this official Chrome page-share capability and its additive public plugin-SDK export as a supported product contract?
rationale: This is a new user-facing browser workflow and expands the plugin SDK; the PR also carries the protected `maintainer` label, so implementation quality alone cannot establish durable product/API direction.

options.title: Approve the scoped feature after repair
options.body: Keep the feature Gateway-only, remove unselected page content from selection payloads, and document the SDK export as the supported plugin-service seam.

options.title: Defer the public surface
options.body: Pause or narrow the feature if maintainers do not want page sharing or another public SDK export in the supported browser/plugin contract yet.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped feature after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the feature Gateway-only, remove unselected page content from selection payloads, and document the SDK export as the supported plugin-service seam.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history shows direct ownership of the proposed browser and relay integration, although the available evidence does not establish formal maintainer authority.
